# Relift

Relift is a Rust CLI and Tauri desktop application for recovering deleted files from raw disk images and devices. Device scans open sources read-only. Recovery requires a separate destination that passes device-separation checks.

- Repository: https://github.com/ShahabAhmed01/relift
- Documentation: https://shahabahmed01.github.io/relift/
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later
- Status: v0.1.0 preview; synthetic-fixture validation only; release assets are unsigned.
